contexts.text: His brother came out afterwards () = good actually prior; for Zarah, who is here the brother, = good; for he it was who opened the womb, and therefore was the firstborn. AC 4930.

Zarah, in the Original Language, means the rising, and is attributed to the sun and the first appearance of its light. This is why he was named Zarah, for such is the case with good in the man who is being regenerated - it rises first and gives light, by which the things in the natural man are enlightened, so that they can be seen, acknowledged, and finally believed...
